dedupe_keys.name: dataset of material assessment of packaging glass and household surveys

description: Häme University of Applied Sciences and Tampere University publish packaging-glass material assessments and household surveys from the KOTILO source-separation project. Work took place from May to December 2024, and the May 2025 Zenodo release provides assessment tables, photographs, methods and combined survey results. Questionnaires distinguish users of property collection bins from users of public collection points. The material is freely available under CC BY 4.0; results are in Finnish, with questionnaires and methods also documented in English. These observations can inform contamination, participation and collection-choice assumptions in waste-system simulations. Geographic coverage is the Finnish project sample; exact municipalities and sample sizes are not established by the landing page. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Selection bias, material-sampling protocols and uncertainty require the supplied documentation before transfer. No household rows, photographs or workbooks were opened.
